newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials hold gains ahead of FOMC outcome.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials hold gains ahead of FOMC outcome.

text.p: The Dow Industrials held on to their healthy tech-led gains, as the market awaited the outcome of the Federal Reserve's deliberations over interest rates.
Analysts expect the Federal Open Market Committee to leave interest rates unchanged when it issues a statement about 1415 EDT/1815 GMT.
The Dow was up 68.52 points or 0.88 percent at 7871.88.
Nasdaq was up 1.57 percent or 24.63 points at 1594.15.
The long bond was up 4/32 to yield 6.51 percent.
